title: check critic fails on Intent's critic exit 4 (nothing judged), so every cut with nothing staged is red
body:
## Problem

Intent's issue 0648 (Intent 82546e69a, in the Intent on PATH, 3.2.6 dev 2d4c941f) gave the headless critic exit 4: a run that asks no rule of any file given prints "nothing was judged ... so this is not a clean verdict" and exits 4. intent-vc ruled 4 deliberate (intent/docs/critics.md, `intent llm guide`): it is never a clean 0, and Intent's own pre-commit gate passes on it, printing the critic's "no <lang> rule was asked" line, and blocks on 1 or 3.

devbin's `check critic` built-in reads it as a failure: lib/cmd/check's builtin_check_critic runs `intent critic "$lang" "$@" || rc=1`. With nothing staged it first warns "nothing staged -- the critic will examine NO files, which is not a failure here", and then fails on the critic's 4. A release cut always runs with nothing staged, so every project whose cut gates on devbin's `check critic` is red under that Intent. Utilz's 2.14.4 release dry run went red there in every declared language (utilz-vc, 2026-10-26; ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/work/c2144/dryrun-2144-f6c36bd.out, sha256 903b30759b5f), where 2.14.3's, before 0648, passed. devbin-vc measured it read-only on devbin's own clean tree: `intent critic shell --staged` exited 4. v0.1.15 carries the defect; devbin's own cut did not meet it because devbin's `check critic` is its shell-gate over the whole corpus.

A skip when nothing is staged is not the fix: a staged file no armed rule reaches (eg a Swift file every rule declines) also exits 4.

## Fix

builtin_check_critic reads each language's exit: 0 and 4 pass, 4 leaving the critic's own line as printed; 1 (findings), 2 (the critic could not answer) and 3 (an armed rule's tool is absent) fail, as does any other code, which is named. devbin fails on 2 where Intent's pre-commit gate fails open, because this gate runs at the cut. The default --staged corpus stays NOT APPLICABLE and announced, and an explicit --files corpus that judges nothing stays red through run_gate's counter. lib/pages/check.md says how each exit is read, and says that devbin differs from Intent's pre-commit gate on 2 and why: a commit gate fails open so a broken critic never stops a commit, while a cut whose critic answered nothing must stop (intent-vc, 2026-10-26: critics.md's "fails open on 2" describes Intent's own gate, not a rule for other callers).

## Done when

- builtin_check_critic passes on 0 and 4 and fails on 1, 2, 3 and any other code, naming a code it does not know; check.md says so, and names the difference from Intent's gate on 2 and its reason.
- builtins.bats's stub critic answers an empty run as Intent 3.2.6 does (exit 4 and its line); arms: nothing staged is green and says no tests ran; a staged file no rule reaches is green; an explicit --files corpus judging nothing is red; exit 1, 2 and 3 are each red.
- Red on main: the not-applicable arm, under the exit-4 stub, fails on main; Utilz's dry run is the field red, cited.
- Green at the fix under BSD and GNU: builtins.bats, dispatch.bats, doctor.bats, help.bats and every tree-scan file, found by population.
- Landed and pushed by vc; CI green on the new head.

## Resolution

Not needed: closed with no change to devbin. hv ruled, relayed by molt-vc on 2026-10-26 by 18:30Z ("1..5: go with the recs"), that Intent's headless critic goes back to exit 0 when nothing was judged, keeping its "no <lang> rule was asked" line and the files_asked JSON field (intent-vc's recommendation, replacing 0648's exit 4). Intent carries the change. With it, builtin_check_critic's `intent critic "$lang" "$@" || rc=1` is right as it stands: 0 passes, and 1 (findings), 2 (the critic could not answer) and 3 (an armed rule's tool is absent) fail, which is also what devbin wants at a cut on 2. The default --staged corpus with nothing in it stays NOT APPLICABLE and announced, and an explicit --files corpus that judges nothing stays red through run_gate's counter.

Until Intent's change is the Intent on PATH, a cut that gates on devbin's `check critic` with nothing staged stays red, as Utilz 2.14.4's dry run was; that wait is Intent's, and no devbin release is cut for it.
